Contents roadmap. No separate question needed for agenda repetition.

Actual pipeline arrows: capture, image processing, feature extraction, decision. Processing returns a modified image; semantics/decisions are separate in this simplified architecture. Scene illumination, reflections, shadows and sensor noise qualify measurements; do not generalize the pipeline to every modern system.

Actual RGB, grayscale and binary illustrations and zoomed pixels inspected. RGB shape (H,W,3), grayscale and binary 2D. uint8 0–255, logical Boolean storage. float32 is a type, not an automatic normalization guarantee.
Coordinate grid inspected: u points right, v down, top-left (0,0); orange (3,2) means third row and fourth column in NumPy, A[2,3].

All raster-only code inspected. flowers9.png shape (640,426,3), uint8, extrema 0 and 255; pixel np_flowers[400,100,:]=[253,23,1]. NumPy red plane [:,:,0]. Printed NumPy [250:400,450:600,:] has empty columns. Intended plotted crop is u250:400,v450:600. Printed Image [450:600,250:400,:] also wrong under the current column-first API. Current runtime rejects its empty result; do not claim it produces a valid empty Image. Correct NumPy rows450:600,cols250:400 versus Image u250:400,v450:600.

Function domain printed H first and W second despite stated (u,v) order. Correct u<W, v<H. Binary H rows 01010,01010,01110,01010,01010 contain 11 foreground cells. Grayscale scalar versus RGB vector codomain inspected.

Street histogram code and plot inspected: count distribution, 256-bin default, clustered rather than exactly three discrete values. Histogram does not retain spatial arrangement; total counts equal image size for a full count histogram.

Histogram mean and spread, dark/bright and contrast illustrations inspected. Low intensity concentration does not establish incorrect exposure without scene context. Spread is not complete spatial edge information. RGB marginal histograms lose joint channel pairings.

Point/spatial-operation illustration inspected. Blanket NumPy modulo-256 wording applies only to retained uint8 arithmetic. Float storage does not itself normalize. Current Image.to float alias is float32 and rescales uint8, unlike the shown float64 comment and plain astype.

Fixed pointwise O(u,v)=f(I(u,v)) keeps coordinates and dimensions, but not guaranteed image improvement. If f is estimated from a histogram, the map depends on global image data even though application is pointwise.

Pollen negative code, figures and reflected intensity histogram inspected. Map 255−I sends source input96 to159; gray-axis reflection is not spatial reflection. The source pollen image is absent from installed official data package, so only stated-value calculations can be claimed as exact reproduction.

Addition and threshold raster code inspected. Adding100 means intensity levels, not pixel displacement. (I>=100) includes the boundary; bool logical storage can display as black/white. Source position text and plot disagree between v350 and v300. Current apply default receives the complete NumPy array, not a scalar.

Linear stretch and gamma raster equations/code/output labels inspected. Min91,max138 and input118 imply 255*(27/47)=146.489..., not shown235. I_min and I_max need explicit definitions when executing excerpt. Plot label coordinate order is inconsistent. Power gamma7.5 at118 gives about0.788; finite integer display differs from exact real values.

normhist code and pollen output inspected. Output remains spiky; equalization cannot guarantee exactly uniform finite counts and can amplify visible noise. Missing pollen asset prevents claiming exact full-image reproduction.

Inclusive cumulative histogram c_k=sum_{l=0}^k h_l/(HW), nondecreasing, final1. Plot c_100 about.32 maps to82 under explicitly defined255 scaling and nearest rounding. Current normhist uses OpenCV equalizeHist with a minimum-CDF adjustment, so do not equate every library output with the displayed raw-CDF formula.

Applications include RGB-to-gray, thresholding, histogram normalization, gamma. A histogram valley is a task-dependent heuristic, not universal optimal segmentation. Simple gamma is not exact piecewise sRGB; no enhancement reconstructs clipped information.
All kernel offset labels and input cells inspected. Half-width h gives (2h+1)^2 positions. Sample [[4,0,1],[1,0,0],[1,2,0]] sums9; normalized3x3 mean1. Correlation positive offsets have no reversal.

Both highlighted H windows and normalized box coefficients inspected: four bright cells gives1020/9; seven gives1785/9. Explicit boundary handling needed outside valid interior. Nonnegative weights summing1 preserve a constant interior.

Gaussian formula, worked numbers, binomial approximation and two H windows inspected. Top exponent omits2 while worked example contains2. Standard2D Gaussian is exp(-r²/(2σ²))/(2πσ²). Finite sampled/truncated sum need not1; normalized3x3σ.85 is not exact printed binomial kernel. Weighted outputs143.4375 and159.375. Distant 3D visualization is illustrative, not a claim of matching these precise parameters.

Convolution minus-offset equation, rotated kernel colors and Fourier relation inspected. Flip both axes, not transpose. Centrosymmetry K(i,j)=K(-i,-j), not transpose symmetry, makes correlation/convolution agree. Fourier multiplication needs compatible padding/boundary conventions; unpadded DFT is circular.

All Mona Lisa code inspected: Image.Read monalisa.png mono=True dtype=float; Kernel.Box(h=15), Kernel.Gauss(sigma=5,h=15), convolve and disp. Both supports31x31 with different weights. Table says box jagged and Gaussian natural; these are illustrative tendencies rather than universal guarantees.

Castle source code and all profile plots inspected. v360, u560:600 gives40 samples; np.diff gives39 aligned with561:600. Rising and falling edges produce positive and negative peaks. Edge need not be physical object boundary. Cast before unsigned differencing when preserving negatives.

Central derivative formula, correlation [-1/2,0,1/2] versus convolution [1/2,0,-1/2], full normalized Sobel and signed plots inspected. Horizontal derivative responds across vertical edges. Sobel transpose exchanges axes. Source uses floating castle, avoiding unsigned clipping/wrap issues.

Border illustration and methods inspected. Valid shape decreases by2h in each axis. Top-left H2x2 has two255 cells: zero-padded3x3 output510/9. Replicate repeats nearest edge; reflection mirrors with API-specific endpoint inclusion. Claim reflection always smoothest is not a universal guarantee.

Median algorithm inspected: gather neighborhood, sort, take middle. Ascending versus descending does not affect odd-window median. General linear filters are not all averages; derivative kernels have signed weights.

Every5x5 matrix cell and both highlighted3x3 windows inspected. First median10, second median9. Source lists column-major but sorting removes listing-order dependence. Q079 and Q081 appear to duplicate the same listing-order angle.

Noisy circuit/output image and literal Image.rank(rank=4,h=1) code inspected. 3x3 median zero-based rank4;5x5 rank12. Current rank is a deprecated but functional wrapper for rankfilter. The source circuit TIFF is not present in the official installed data; exact output reproduction cannot be claimed. Median can destroy narrow features and cannot guarantee all noise removal.

Applications: box/Gaussian smoothing, median impulse suppression, correlation template matching, Sobel gradients. Claims of eliminating all impulse noise and preserving every sharp feature require qualification. Raw correlation is not normalized probability and depends on brightness/contrast.
